note: Tajikistan, read on 2026-10-30 on the Ministry of Internal Affairs' list of the Passport and Registration Service's services (mvd.tj), in its Tajik version, with the Russian and English versions of the same page. The residence document (санади зист; the Russian page calls it 'акт о проживании', the English 'residence certificate') is issued to foreign citizens and stateless persons and its term extended; for its issue the Service charges 800 somoni and for an extension 400 somoni under the Ministry's order 400б/з of 5 June 2013, on top of a state duty under the Law on State Duty of 28 January 2004 No. 19, which the three versions of the page give as 156, 150 and 144 somoni (the duty is set in the law's unit of account, whose value is revised each year, so the versions differ by date). A first issue's fee is therefore the service's 800 somoni plus a duty no version states for today with certainty, and no fee is written; the 800 somoni alone would stand for part of the fee. Its term can be extended, so it is renewable. The page doesn't say what the document is for (it is issued to foreigners and stateless persons generally, so written as `general`), how long it lasts, where it is applied for, or what work it allows; no work permit or other residence route is on the page. The Law on the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens wasn't read.

sources.title: Вазорати корҳои дохилии Ҷумҳурии Тоҷикистон, Номгӯи хизматрасониҳои Хадамоти шиносномавию бақайдгирӣ
sources.said: Барои додани санади зист ба шаҳрвандони хориҷӣ ва шахсони бешаҳрванд ва тамдид намудани муҳлати он дар асоси Қонуни Ҷумҳурии Тоҷикистон аз 28 январи соли 2004, №19 «Дар бораи боҷи давлатӣ» 156 сомонӣ боҷи давлатӣ ва тибқи Фармони ВКД аз 5 июни соли 2013 таҳти №400б/з барои додани санади зист 800 сомонӣ ва тамдиди муҳлати амали он 400 сомонӣ хизматрасонии Хадамоти шиносномавию бақайдгирӣ пешбинӣ шудааст.
